title: Spurious Information in Large Markets: Random Matrix Laws for Entropy, Mutual Information and the Value of Information
abstract: arXiv:2611.30998v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Entropy, Kullback-Leibler divergence and mutual information have become standard currencies for measuring how much one set of financial variables reveals about another. In large cross-sections they are almost always computed from sample covariance matrices, and the noise in those matrices is the object of random matrix theory. This paper develops the random matrix theory of Gaussian information functionals and applies it to markets. I show that the plug-in mutual information between two blocks of p and r variables estimated from $n$ observations has an exact expected excess, the spurious information, that is a digamma telescope independent of the true dependence. Under independence its law is that of a product of Beta variables. In the proportional regime it grows linearly with an order-one variance. The same quantity is a linear spectral statistic of the Jacobi ensemble, which yields a closed form for the logarithmic moment of Wachter's

translated_title: 大市场中的虚假信息：熵、互信息与信息价值的随机矩阵定律
translated_abstract: 熵、Kullback-Leibler散度和互信息已经成为衡量一组金融变量揭示另一组金融变量信息量的标准度量。在大截面数据中，这些量几乎总是由样本协方差矩阵计算得出，而这些矩阵中的噪声正是随机矩阵理论所研究的对象。本文发展了高斯信息泛函的随机矩阵理论并将其应用于市场。我证明了由n个观测值估计的分别包含p个和r个变量的两个变量块之间的插件互信息，存在一个精确的期望超出量——即虚假信息——它是一个与真实依赖结构无关的双伽马望远镜。在独立性假设下，其分布律为Beta变量的乘积。在成比例渐近机制下，该虚假信息随阶为一的方差线性增长。同一量也是Jacobi系综的线性谱统计量，由此得到了Wachter分布对数矩的闭式表达式。
tldr: 本文发展了高斯信息泛函的随机矩阵理论，证明了大截面金融数据中基于样本协方差矩阵估计的互信息存在一个与真实依赖无关的精确期望超出量（虚假信息），并给出了其分布律与闭式表达式。
en_tdlr: This paper develops the random matrix theory of Gaussian information functionals, proving that plug-in mutual information estimated from sample covariance matrices in large financial cross-sections carries an exact spurious excess independent of the true dependence, with precise distributional laws and closed-form expressions.
